name: pca_projection_illustration
caption: Chunk embeddings projected onto their first two principal components, coloured by window turnover t/W and connected in generation order. W=2,048, chunk=512 tokens. Illustration only: all statistics reported in this project are computed in the full high-dimensional space.
alt_text: Scatter of chunk embeddings in two principal components, connected in time order.
limitations: A 2-D projection cannot establish the existence, number, or separation of clusters. Nothing in this figure may be used as evidence; see the Markov-state analysis.
